title: Repair Windows parallel snapshot cleanup and cancellation
head: 100b46506a55e7fceb36918a8e127a5dbc45d815
body:
Native Windows Git snapshots contain read-only object files. The existing snapshot runner raises PermissionError during cleanup before it can report a successful group; its interruption handler also unconditionally calls os.killpg, which Windows does not provide. This change gives owned snapshots a narrow read-only retry and terminates active verifier trees with taskkill on Windows (process groups on POSIX), closing log handles before cleanup.

Three focused real-process tests pass on native Windows / CPython 3.12.14: a genuine temporary Git snapshot completes and is removed; cancellation preserves KeyboardInterrupt, reaps the worker, and removes the snapshot; a read-only object is removed while an outside sibling remains unchanged. The exact pre-change read-only failure was reproduced during the preceding parallel-entrypoint regression. No tests regenerate mathematical artifacts or remove user checkouts. This is separate from PR2495's assertion-environment repair and PR2035's Windows memory-budget work.
